summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests an infusion of CD34-selected blood stem cells, processed with the automated CliniMACS Prodigy system, in people who had an allogeneic stem cell transplant for a blood cancer. The cells are given by infusion as a stem cell boost for graft failure or low graft function, with or without preceding conditioning with fludarabine and total body irradiation at the clinician's discretion; how often or how long is not stated. The main outcome is not stated in the record; the study is listed as Phase 1.
summary_es: Este estudio de Fase 1 prueba una infusión de células madre de sangre seleccionadas por CD34, procesadas con el sistema automatizado CliniMACS Prodigy, en personas que recibieron un trasplante alogénico de células madre por un cáncer de la sangre. Las células se administran por infusión como un refuerzo de células madre por falla del injerto o función baja del injerto, con o sin acondicionamiento previo con fludarabina y radiación corporal total a criterio del clínico; la frecuencia o la duración no se indican. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; el estudio aparece como Fase 1.
who_for: Prior allogeneic stem cell transplant with graft failure or low graft function needing a CD34-selected stem cell boost
Certain blood cancers in remission, such as AML, ALL, lymphoma, CLL, MDS, CML, or myelofibrosis, per listed criteria
Negative donor-specific antibody test within 28 days of conditioning, or adequate for standard desensitization
not_for: Uncontrolled medical or psychiatric disorder, per attending physician
